title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Agreement — Schedule of Term, Notice and Package Change Limits
content:
## Schedule

Under the Paystride Payroll Card Program agreement each package carries the minimum initial term, the calendar days of written notice to terminate, the package's early termination fee, and the package changes allowed in any rolling 365 days.

| Package | Minimum initial term (months) | Written notice to terminate (calendar days) | Early termination fee of the package (USD) | Package changes allowed in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 12 | 30 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 12 | 30 | 250.00 | 1 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 12 | 30 | 500.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 24 | 60 | 1000.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 24 | 60 | 2500.00 | 2 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 36 | 90 | 5000.00 | 2 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The figures of a row apply to a program held in that package.
2. The Essential package's early termination fee is zero.
3. The Essential and Standard packages allow one package change in any rolling 365 days; the other packages allow two.
4. Hypothetical reading: an Advantage package program has a minimum initial term of 24 months and a notice period of 60 calendar days; the same figures under the Elite package are 36 months and 90 calendar days.
